summary: Job template fields: Project, Source control branch (only for projects allowing branch override, blank uses the project branch), Playbook (from the project base path, or typed), Execution Environment (needs a project first) and Credentials, with prompted credentials replacing a default of the same type.
questions: Why don't I see a Source control branch field in my job template?
Why is my playbook not listed in the job template?
Why can't I select an execution environment in the job template?
How do prompted credentials replace default credentials?
